reference.template_layout: parameter layout written by Diva build 16519 (401 lines)

confidence_levels.high: Name from the official VST parameter list AND behaviour/range consistent with the manual and observed presets.
confidence_levels.medium: Two independent sources agree, or one authoritative source plus consistent observations.
confidence_levels.low: Single source or our own inference; use with care and verify in Diva.
confidence_levels.unknown: Meaning not established. Value is preserved but never set by diva-mcp.
